dialogue.translation: What do you think about the connection of remote work? Woman: I can handle that kind of thing.

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Biko, maara gị ihe nweta n'okpuru ndoro nkeji ndoro ndoro?
dialogue.translation: Please, do you know what people get from one experience to another these days?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: O! O gaa nke ọma kwa.Ọmụma ndoro ndoro dị mma, mana eji ya n'ụzọ ọzọ.
dialogue.translation: Oh! It’s very good. Experience brings knowledge, but it is also used in other ways.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Kedu maara ndị a nwere n'ime ziri n'ime ọrụ ha? Ọmalite n'ime ụlọ oru?
dialogue.translation: How much do these people know about what they do? Did they start from home or outside?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ah! E kwere na ọ bụ nkeji ndoro ndoro.Ụlọ ọrụ kwadoro ndoro nkeji nkeji.
dialogue.translation: Ah! It depends on the time of experience. Workplaces provide different experiences at different times.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Nke a pụtara na ndoro ndoro si n'ime ziri dị egwu ma ọ bụ eziokwu?
dialogue.translation: Does this mean that experiences from daily activities are terrifying or real?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Eziokwu! Ma ọ bụ ike nke nweta nke a kwadoro ndoro ndoro.
dialogue.translation: It’s true! But the power gained from these experiences is strong.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Haa! Nke a pụtara na ndoro ndoro si n'ime nkwado ndị a nwere ọtụtụ ike?
dialogue.translation: Hmm! Does this mean experiences from these supports have many strengths?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ee! Ma tụlee, tụlụ ndoro ndoro nwere ike inwe ike maara.
dialogue.translation: Yes! But before that, experiences must be strong to have knowledge.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ọzuzu ọkụ na-esị n'ụlọ nke ahụ, kwa? Mgbe anyị chọrọ ịchị nke ụlọ, anyị nwere ike ịgba n'ọzọ.

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ụlọ ahụ dị mma, mana ọnwanyi nke ahụ nwere ike ịtụle ọzụzụ n'ime ọnụ.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ahụ! Ọzuzu ọkụ na-esị n'ụlọ ahụ, ndoro la, ịgba ndoro!
dialogue.translation: Ah! It’s getting warmer in that house, really, run quickly!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Nke a pụrụ mma n'obi, mana m ga-achọ ịbanye n'ụlọ ahụ n'ịrị.
dialogue.translation: This could be good, but I need to enter that house immediately.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ọ bụrụ na ị gaghị eme, biko gafee n'ụzọ ndoro ka ị ghara ịtụle ọzụzụ n'ime ọnụ.
dialogue.translation: If you don’t do it, please return quickly on the road so you don’t whisper secrets in someone’s ear.

key_phrases.phrase: Ee, ndoro kwara m n'ụlọ, mgbe m hụ ya n'ime ọnwa mbụ.
key_phrases.translation: Yes, it was in the hospital when I saw it in the first month.

key_phrases.phrase: N'ime ọnwa mbụ, ọ bụrụ na ọrịa gị ghara, ịnụ m ga-emeri ọkụ n'ọnụ gị?
key_phrases.translation: In the first month, if your illness stopped, would you still feel the heat in your mouth?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mmepụta nwetara n'ulo anyị n'ihi na anyị nwere ọkwa ike ịkpọm mmadụ nwere njo.
dialogue.translation: Humor has an effect in our home because we truly have the ability to make people laugh.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ọkwa! Maka n'obi anyị bụ ọkwa ike ịmalite ịchọpụta ndoro na nkọwa anyị.
dialogue.translation: Really! Because in our hearts, we truly have the ability to start laughing at our own jokes.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ee, mana ọzọ nwere mmepụta n'ihi na mmadụ nwere ike ịgbalịa n'ike ha nwere n'ime ọrịa ndoro ha.
dialogue.translation: Yes, but humor also has an effect because people can recover with their own sense of humor during difficult times.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Olee ka ịkpọm ndoro a? Maka m na-achọ ịmụ nkọwa ndoro nke ndoro ndoro.
dialogue.translation: What do you call this humor? Because I want to learn the kind of humor that makes people laugh.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ndoro kpọm mmụọ ọzọ, nke na-eme ka ndoro na-arị ịrịba n'ike na ndoro anyị.
dialogue.translation: Humor is called 'spirit' too, which makes laughter and joy strengthen our hearts.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Nwere onye na-enye ndoro na-arịba ndoro, olee ndoro a kpọm?
dialogue.translation: Is there someone who brings laughter and joy? What is this humor called?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Olee ka ị bụ ndoro a nwere mmepụta n'ụlọ anyị? Emeela n'ihi na anyị nwere ike ịbụ ndoro ndoro.
dialogue.translation: What kind of humor has an effect in our home? It's because we can be laughter itself.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ọkwa! Ndoro bụ nke na-egosi mmadụ na ha na-adị mma n'obi ha.
dialogue.translation: Truly! Humor is what shows people that they are doing well in their hearts.

key_phrases.phrase: Mmepụta nwetara n'ihi na anyị nwere ọkwa ike.
key_phrases.translation: Humor has an effect because we truly have the ability.

key_phrases.phrase: Ndoro kpọm mmụọ ọzọ, nke na-eme ka ndoro na-arị ịrịba n'ike.
key_phrases.translation: Humor is called 'spirit' too, which makes laughter strengthen our hearts.

dialogue.speaker: Researcher
dialogue.text: Ezigbo mmadụ, ndị a mma n'ihi mụrụ m ego ndoro n'ịdị mma. Ọtụtụ ndị a na-akpọ 'research findings' n'ọnụ nke anyị.
dialogue.translation: Good people, these are because I have gathered good data. Many call these 'research findings' in our language.

dialogue.speaker: Colleague
dialogue.text: Ịmara ihe ndoro a? Mmere ya dịkwuo mma n'ịmara ya.
dialogue.translation: Have you understood this data? The way you explain it is so good that I understand it.

dialogue.speaker: Researcher
dialogue.text: Ezigbo! N'ihi a, m chere n'ọtụtụ mmadụ na-akwụ ọsọ n'ọnụ.

speaker: Colleague

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ọ dịghị anya ị nweta tụọnụ nke ị na-emepụta tụ ọzọ.
dialogue.translation: It's not easy to gain freedom that you create for others again.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ọ bụ ndị tụọnụ tụ tụọnụ tụ tụọnụ tụ tụọnụ tụ tụọnụ tụ tụọnụ tụ tụọnụ.
dialogue.translation: But it's those with freedom that create freedom for others.

dialogue.translation: Effort is good, but freedom is rare.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Gịnị ka tụọnụ tụ tụọnụ tụ tụọnụ tụ tụọnụ tụ tụọnụ tụ tụọnụ tụ tụọnụ?

dialogue.translation: Freedom means being able to make choices without hindrance.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ọ dịghị mma tụ tụọnụ tụ tụọnụ tụ tụọnụ tụ tụọnụ tụ tụọnụ tụ tụọnụ tụ.
dialogue.translation: It's not easy to achieve that kind of freedom.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: E kwuo tụ tụọnụ tụ tụọnụ tụ tụọnụ tụ tụọnụ tụ tụọnụ tụ tụọnụ tụ tụọnụ.
dialogue.translation: They say freedom is a gift that must be shared.

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ọ bụ nke ị kpọm n'ime ọrụ a nwere ezi n'ọdịnihu?
dialogue.translation: Is that the one you call the best in this work currently?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ee, mana ịchọrọ ịtụ aro n'ime nke a. ịchọta n'ọdịnihu.
dialogue.translation: Yes, but you need to judge properly in this. I want it now.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mana n'ime ndị ọrụ a, nwere nke na-ezi na nke na-enweghị mme.
dialogue.translation: But among these workers, there are the good ones and those with no discipline.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Nwetara ọnọdụ ọhụrụ n'ime nke a, mana n'agbata a na-emepụta ndoro.
dialogue.translation: It has brought a new situation in this, but suddenly it is creating problems.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ọ bụ nke a kpọm n'ime ọrụ? Ọ bụ na ndoro a na-emepụta?
dialogue.translation: Is that what you call in the work? Is it what is causing the problem?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ee, nke a bụ n'ime ọrụ. Nwere nke na-egbu ndoro n'ime nke a.
dialogue.translation: Yes, this is in the work. Some are causing problems in it.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mana ị chọrọ ịtụ aro n'ime nke a n'ọdịnihu. Ọ ga-eme mma.
dialogue.translation: But you need to judge properly in this now. It will be fine.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ee, ịchọta n'ọdịnihu. Ọ bụ n'ime ọrụ a nwere ike ịme mma.
dialogue.translation: Yes, I want it now. It is within this work that there is the power to do well.
